turns.replyText:
Hello,

Thanks so much for reaching out to us!

We totally understand that sometimes plans change, however, once an order is placed, we’re unable to cancel, modify, refund, return, or exchange it due to how quickly our system begins processing. 💻✨

That said, if you just placed your order, you’ve got a 30-minute window to update your shipping address yourself! Just head over to your order dashboard here:

🔗 https://account.evryjewels.com/orders/

After that window, we’re unable to make changes, as outlined in our refund policy, located within the “Help” section accessible at the bottom of our website or during the checkout process.

We also want to reassure you that all purchases go through Shopify’s secure, encrypted checkout. If you used Shop Pay or Apple Pay, the process might’ve felt super quick but rest assured, it was still a fully authorized transaction.

We truly appreciate your understanding and support. If you have any other questions, we’re always here to help. 💎

turns.q: Can I add an item to an order I already placed?
turns.replyTail:
Adding an item would modify the order, and once an order is placed, we’re unable to cancel, modify, refund, return, or exchange it due to how quickly our system begins processing. 💻✨

You can place the additional item as a separate order through our website.

turns.q: What happens if it already shipped, can it still be changed?
turns.replyTail: If you mean adding an item, no, an order can’t be modified once it has shipped. You would need to place the additional item as a separate order. If you mean the shipping address, the self-service window is only available for 30 minutes after placing the order, so it can’t be changed after shipment.

turns.q: If I cancel, how long until I'm refunded?
turns.replyTail: Orders can’t be cancelled after they’re placed, so there isn’t a refund timeline for cancellations. The 30-minute window applies only to updating the shipping address, not cancelling the order.

turns.replyTail: Please send your order number, the email address used at checkout, or the phone number on the order so I can check whether it’s still eligible for a change.

turns.q: Can I combine two separate orders into one shipment?
turns.replyTail: No, separate orders can’t be combined into one shipment after they’re placed. They’ll remain as two separate orders, and any future items would need to be placed in a new order. 💻✨

turns.q: Can I change the payment method on my order?
turns.replyTail: No, the payment method can’t be changed after an order has been placed. If you need to use a different payment method, it would need to be used for a separate new order.

turns.q: Will I get an email confirmation once the change is made?
turns.replyTail: No payment-method change can be made after an order is placed, so there won’t be a confirmation email for that type of change. If you mean a different account update, tell me which detail you’d like to change.
